description: This file contains unit tests for exception safety testing utilities in the Abseil library, including tests for throwing values, allocators, invariants, and exception safety guarantees.

classes.name: ExhaustivenessTester
classes.description: Template class used to test exhaustiveness of certain operations with different types.

classes.name: NonNegative
classes.description: A struct representing a non-negative integer with comparison operators.

classes.name: NonCopyable
classes.description: A non-copyable struct used in exception safety tests.

classes.name: NonEqualityComparable
classes.description: A struct lacking equality comparison, used to test behavior with non-equality comparable types.

methods.name: ExpectNoThrow
methods.description: Template function that runs a function and expects no exceptions, catching TestException.

methods.name: TestOp
methods.description: Template function that tests if an operation throws or not, based on a countdown.
